description: Adversarial go test -json streams for the case-evidence tool. Every entry names its fixture, whether generation must accept it, and (for rejections) a regex a finding must match. Fixture 16 is syntactically valid: its rejection is a PROVENANCE rejection — a syntactically valid stream produced without an authenticated runner is not qualification evidence — so generation accepts it but the emitted record must carry no CI provenance off-CI, which a CI-bound release gate refuses.

fixtures.name: completely empty stream presented as a run
package PASS without a preceding START
empty package name on every event
empty test name on test-scoped events
NaN elapsed value (nonstandard JSON constant)
fixtures.want: not a go test -json event line|nonstandard numeric constant

fixtures.name: Infinity elapsed value (nonstandard JSON constant)
fixtures.want: not a go test -json event line|nonstandard numeric constant

fixtures.name: test never reaches a terminal outcome
package never reaches a terminal outcome
package records a second start event
test records a duplicate terminal outcome
fixtures.want: after its terminal outcome|2 terminal events

fixtures.name: test passes after it already failed
fixtures.want: after its terminal outcome|duplicate run|2 terminal events

fixtures.name: package reports pass while a test failed
completed package containing no test cases
valid-looking stream without authenticated runner provenance
fixtures.provenance_gate: the emitted record carries no CI provenance off-CI; a CI-qualified gate refuses it as unauthenticated evidence
